samples.input: Mina led the weekly design review, asked quiet teammates for input, and turned vague feedback into clear next steps. She shared early drafts and adjusted quickly when research contradicted her first idea.

profile.summary: Mina demonstrates observable behaviors in design leadership: facilitating inclusive input gathering by actively seeking contributions from quiet teammates during reviews; synthesizing ambiguous feedback into specific action items; practicing iterative work sharing through early draft distribution; and adapting plans rapidly when new research contradicts initial assumptions.
profile.workingStyle: Collaborative and adaptive approach to design processes, prioritizing team input and responsiveness to new information.
